whatIs.title: What is AuditSoft?
paragraphs: AuditSoft is a system to plan, execute and document internal and external audits with order and traceability.
It centralizes checklists, findings, evidence and action plans so your team meets deadlines, standards and regulations without relying on scattered spreadsheets or folders.

whoIsItFor.title: Who is it for?
whoIsItFor.subtitle: If you need to document audits clearly, track findings and deliver reports on time, AuditSoft is your solution.

items.author: María López, Audit Director
items.intro: A consulting firm adopted AuditSoft to standardize internal reviews and cut report preparation time for financial-sector clients.
items.quote: We used to build every report from scratch in spreadsheets. With AuditSoft we have templates, organized evidence and findings follow-up in one place. We deliver faster with fewer errors.
items.closing: We recommend it to any team that needs to professionalize audits without overcomplicating day-to-day work.
